questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.

Hello, everyone. My name is David Parker, and I'm a photographer. Today, I'm going to tell you how I find my dream and realized it. I hope that my story can inspire you.

When I was young, I loved stars. I also liked taking pictures. However, I never thought these things could lead __(A)__ a job. In fact, I didn't have a dream at all.

When I had to decide __(B)__ a major in college, I chose engineering. Being an engineer looked OK. After college, I got a job at an engineering company. It was a stable job, but I didn't know whether did I really enjoy it.

Everything changed when I went __(C)__ vacation to Iceland one winter. There I got a chance seeing the Northern Lights. The lights were amazing, and I took many pictures of the dancing lights in the sky. For the first time in many years, I could feel my heart to beat fast.

빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) lead to: ~로 이어지다 (B) decide on: ~에 결정하다 (C) go on vacation: 휴가를 가다

options: Why did he like taking pictures?
What did he like when he was young?
Which country did he visit one winter?
How did he feel about his job as an engineer?
How did he feel when he took pictures of the Northern Lights?

A : I really liked your book about training dogs. ( A )
S : Thank you. Do you like dogs?
A : Yes, I do. I love all kinds of animals. ( B )
S : Have you ever thought of becoming an animal doctor?
A : Yes. I have. I really want to become an animal doctor. ( C )
S : What are you doing to achieve your goal?
A : I'm doing volunteer work at the local animal house. ( D )
S : That's good. What else are you doing?

questions.question:
글의 전체 흐름을 고려할 때 (가), (나), (다)를 가장 적절하게 배열한 것은?

(가) In college, he chose engineering as his major. After college, he got a job at an engineering company. It was a stable job, but he didn't know whether he really enjoyed it.

(나) Everything changed when he went on vacation to Iceland one winter. There he got a chance to see the Northern Lights. The lights were amazing, and he took many pictures of the dancing lights in the sky. For the first time, he could feel his heart to beat fast.

(다) When David Parker was young, he loved stars. He also liked taking pictures. ___㉮___, he never thought these things could lead to a job ___ ㉯___, he didn't have a dream at all.
questions.explanation: 시간 순서와 논리적 흐름을 고려하면, 먼저 어린 시절의 관심사(다), 그 다음 대학과 직업(가), 마지막으로 변화의 계기인 아이슬란드 여행(나) 순서가 가장 적절하다.

Then one day, I made a bold decision. I quit my job and decided to take pictures for a living. I wasn't sure if I could succeed, but I decided to try. I really wanted to do ㉯something that made me happy. Now, I'm a professional photographer, and I'm happy.

윗글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중에서 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓓ 'There I got a chance see the Northern Lights'는 문법적 오류이다. 'a chance to see'가 올바른 형태이다. 나머지는 모두 문법적으로 올바르다.

options: feeling a need to drink something
doing a job as a way of earning money
questions.question:
[지문]
Manny : I heard that you were a professional soccer player.
Gloria : Yes, I used to play soccer for a living, but I quit because of a knee injury.

밑줄 친 단어의 뜻으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 'for a living'은 '생계를 위해', '돈을 벌기 위해'라는 의미로 '일을 직업으로 하여 돈을 버는 것'을 뜻한다.

options: 여러분이 무엇을 하고 싶은지 그리고 여러분을 행복하게 하는 것이 무엇인지 생각해보세요.
인생을 바꿀 결정을 하기 위해서는 용기가 필요합니다.
questions.question:
[지문]
So do you want to find a dream and realize it? Here's some advice to help you.

First, follow your heart. Think about what you like to do and what makes you happy. In my case, it was taking pictures of stars.

Second, work hard. Pursuing a dream is not easy. I became a photographer through hard work.

Third, be bold. You need courage to make decisions that will change your life. I was afraid but I took a chance. I truly hope you can find a dream, pursue it, and live it!

다음 지문에서 설명하는 꿈을 실현하기 위한 조언으로 언급되지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 언급된 조언은 '마음을 따르라(follow your heart)', '열심히 일하라(work hard)', '대담해지라(be bold)'이다. '쉽지 않은 꿈을 추구하세요'는 언급되지 않았다. '열심히 일하라'는 것이 언급되었지만, 선택지 ③은 '쉽지 않은 꿈을 추구하라'는 의미로 다르다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 올바르게 쓰인 문장을 모두 찾은 것은?

ⓐ I have a question to ask you.
ⓑ I have hot something to drink.
ⓒ I'm looking for a nice hotel to stay.
ⓓ I didn't know when the party began.
ⓔ Do you have enough money to buy a car?
ⓕ I wonder whether or not Dave will come to school.
ⓖ He wants to know whether is he going in the right direction.
questions.explanation:
ⓐ 정확 - 'have + 명사 + to 부정사'는 올바른 구조
ⓑ 오류 - 'hot'은 형용사, 'something to drink'와 어색. 'I have something hot to drink'가 올바름
ⓒ 오류 - 'a hotel to stay'는 부자연스럽고, 'a hotel to stay in' 또는 'a hotel to stay at'이 올바름
ⓓ 정확 - 간접의문문으로 올바른 어순
ⓔ 정확 - 'have + 명사 + to 부정사'는 올바른 구조
ⓕ 정확 - 'whether or not'은 올바른 표현
ⓖ 오류 - 간접의문문에서는 'whether he is going'으로 원래 순서를 유지해야 함
